payload.title: ground documents still bind every sign to cold decode
payload.body: The prime principle now scopes the cold-decode oracle to the corpus's core agent dimension names and values (amended 2026-09-30T10:05). The hand-authored ground documents still state the older reach: ENGINE.md:21 'canonizable(skill) ⇒ ∀ w ∈ declarations(skill) : signify-verify(w)' (formal blocks as the symbolic-σ* regression suite), MODEL.md:43 'SIGNIFIED : ∀c∈concepts(a): α(c)=σ*(c)', and VISION.md:175 'semantic bindings are tested against model priors before they are admitted to the canon'. Plan loop-friction's unit oracle-scope leaves ground documents alone, since they are hand-authored and not the planner's to cut; whether and how they follow the amended concept is the design-holder's call. Observed at a9258730.
